subject.title: feat(macos): onboarding mascot reacts with moods, randomized idle behavior, and Easter eggs

question: Should the Apple apps adopt the full mood, randomized idle, auto-sleep, pointer-gaze, and Easter-egg behavior across macOS onboarding and About plus the selected iOS hero marks?
rationale: This is a technically sound new product-personality surface rather than a repair to an established contract, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit ownership of the cross-app interaction scope.

options.title: Adopt full interaction set
options.body: Approve all proposed moods and Easter eggs on the selected native surfaces, subject to conflict refresh and integrated exact-head validation.

options.title: Limit to onboarding moods
options.body: Keep the shared animator and macOS state-driven expressions while deferring randomized idle behavior and interactions outside onboarding.

options.title: Retain current mascot
options.body: Decline the expanded interaction model and preserve the existing fixed animation loop.

recommendation.title: Adopt full interaction set
recommendation.body: Approve all proposed moods and Easter eggs on the selected native surfaces, subject to conflict refresh and integrated exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and repeatedly maintained the current mascot, macOS onboarding, and About behavior, making them the strongest available product-direction owner.
